prompt:
Create an original horizontal full-body group illustration of FOUR adult hobbits of Bree, TWO men and TWO women, for The One Ring culture art collection. They are town residents, dressed more neatly and urban than Shire country travelers. Match the recent culture group illustrations' fine warm muted brown pencil and pen contours, moderate selective directional hatching and limited crosshatching in shadow pockets, broad pale ivory paper highlights. Moderate simplified detail, not dense photorealistic texture or sparse cartoon.
Left a standing middle-aged hobbit woman with neatly arranged curly hair, simple soft bonnet, tidy long dress, fitted short jacket and small belt purse, carrying a little woven shopping basket at waist. Center-left a standing adult hobbit man with short combed curls, clean-shaven round face and sideburns, fitted town coat, buttoned waistcoat, collared shirt, loose neckcloth and knee breeches, one hand near waistcoat pocket and other holding a plain soft cap. Center-right a seated older hobbit man with thinning curls, friendly shrewd face and modest side whiskers, practical neat wool coat and waistcoat, holding a small plain mug, seated on a low wooden bench. Right a standing young adult hobbit woman with shoulder-length tidy curls, simple long town dress with buttoned bodice and a small shoulder shawl, holding a closed little ledger at waist. Distinct adult hobbit faces, subtly pointed ears, compact rounded bodies and large bare hairy feet. Natural hands, quiet sociable familiarity, no theatrical poses. Garments modestly prosperous but practical, minimal stitched trim. No travelling cloaks, leaf clasps, farm tools or modern business suits.
Approximately 16:10 landscape composition, all four full figures spread comfortably across frame, include all heads, bare feet, basket and bench with generous pale margins. Mostly blank nearly white ivory paper background with only faint sketch hatch marks behind shoulders and ground marks beneath feet fading away; no town scenery. Hair drawn in grouped curls with cream gaps, clothing folds with economical hatch strokes, small dark brown recesses beneath lapels, shawl and chair. No text, lettering on book, border, watermark, full color, smooth realistic shading, gray graphite wash or thick cartoon contours. Four adult hobbits only.
